description: Puts the files of a collection into one ZIP file and returns a file reference. Save the reference with a Create or Update step: this step does not store it in a record.
label: ZIP

options.name: collection
options.label: Collection to read files from
options.info: A collection variable with the records whose files go into the ZIP. Records without a file are skipped.

options.name: property-source
options.label: Property to read files from
options.info: The file or image property of the collection's model that holds the files. Files with the same name get _1, _2 before the extension.

options.name: model-target
options.label: Model to save file into
options.info: The model of the Create or Update step that saves the ZIP. The file reference only fits that model and property.

options.name: property-target
options.label: Property to save file into
options.info: The file property the ZIP will be saved in by the Create or Update step after this one.

options.name: file-name
options.label: Name for the ZIP file
options.info: The file name; .zip is added unless the name already ends in it.

options.name: reference
options.label: As
options.info: The file reference of the ZIP. Put it in the file property with a Create or Update step.
